SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Diversity and interpersonal skills is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Diversity and interpersonal skills as rumours only.
   B. Say Diversity and interpersonal skills never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Diversity and interpersonal skills.
   D. Explain Diversity and interpersonal skills with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Name the president
   D. Measure rainfall only

3. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

4. Which statement about Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe.

5. Which statement about Self- Improvement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Self- Improvement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Self- Improvement never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Self- Improvement as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Improvement.

6. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   C. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Scientific Theory about Human Origin is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Scientific Theory about Human Origin as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Scientific Theory about Human Origin.
   C. Say Scientific Theory about Human Origin never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Scientific Theory about Human Origin with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Self- Esteem Assessment is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Self- Esteem Assessment never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Self- Esteem Assessment with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Self- Esteem Assessment as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Esteem Assessment.

9. Which statement about Vegetation in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Vegetation in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation in Africa.
   C. Say Vegetation in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Vegetation in Africa as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Trans Saharan Slave Trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Trans Saharan Slave Trade.
   B. Treat Trans Saharan Slave Trade as rumours only.
   C. Say Trans Saharan Slave Trade never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Trans Saharan Slave Trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nairobi
   D. Nakuru

12. Which statement about Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration.
   B. Treat Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration as rumours only.
   C. Say Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Population Growth in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Diversity and interpersonal skills and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Map Reading and Interpretation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
